mcqs.question: The Akash air defence system was exported to which two countries by 1 October 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Akash was exported to Tajikistan and Turkmenistan by 1 October 2026. Armenia is a tempting trap because it was the first foreign user of Akash, but it is not one of the two countries named for this export.

mcqs.question: Which Indian vaccine received WHO prequalification in October 2026?
mcqs.explanation: CERVAVAC received WHO prequalification; it is India’s first indigenous quadrivalent HPV vaccine. Serum Institute of India is the manufacturer, while WHO 90–70–90 is a global cervical-cancer elimination strategy rather than the vaccine’s name.
